name: Express res.sendFile/res.download with raw request path
attack_scenario: attacker requests filename=../../../../etc/passwd; sendFile resolves outside the data directory and returns arbitrary server files
negative_test_hint: request filename = "../../../../etc/passwd" and assert the response is an error rather than the contents of /etc/passwd

exemplar.explanation: Passing a request value straight into res.sendFile/res.download without basename/normalize lets '../' sequences escape the intended directory; the root option alone does not neutralise traversal. Stripping the path down to its basename keeps the served file inside the data directory.
